WITH iso AS (
    SELECT iso_id, iso_code
    FROM core.dim_iso
    WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
), peaks AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.interval_start_local, b.demand_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
    WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
), peak_rows AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc, p.interval_start_local, p.demand_mw
    FROM peaks p
    WHERE p.rn = 1
), shares AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(MAX(p_net.net_generation_mw), 0) * 100.0 AS renewable_share_pct
    FROM peak_rows p
    JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
      ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly p_net
      ON p_net.iso_id = p.iso_id AND p_net.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    GROUP BY p.iso_id
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN s.renewable_share_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN s.renewable_share_pct END) AS percentage_point_difference
FROM shares s
JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = s.iso_id

WITH iso AS (
  SELECT iso_id, iso_code
  FROM core.dim_iso
  WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
), daily_peaks AS (
  SELECT b.iso_id, i.iso_code, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY b.iso_id
           ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN iso i USING (iso_id)
  WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
), peak AS (
  SELECT iso_id, iso_code, interval_start_utc, demand_mw
  FROM daily_peaks
  WHERE rn = 1
), fuel_at_peak AS (
  SELECT p.iso_code, p.interval_start_utc,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw,
         SUM(g.generation_mw) AS total_generation_mw
  FROM peak p
  JOIN core.fact_generation_5min g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc >= p.interval_start_utc
       AND g.interval_start_utc < p.interval_start_utc + INTERVAL '1 hour'
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f USING (fuel_id)
  GROUP BY p.iso_code, p.interval_start_utc
), shares AS (
  SELECT iso_code, 100.0 * wind_solar_mw / NULLIF(total_generation_mw, 0) AS share_pct
  FROM fuel_at_peak
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN share_pct END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN share_pct END) AS answer
FROM shares

WITH netload AS (
    SELECT g.interval_start_utc,
           MAX(g.interval_start_local) AS interval_start_local,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code = 'other' THEN g.generation_mw END) AS demand_mw,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code = 'wind' THEN g.generation_mw END) AS wind_mw,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code = 'solar' THEN g.generation_mw END) AS solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id

    WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
      AND CAST(g.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
    GROUP BY g.interval_start_utc
), ranked AS (
    SELECT interval_start_utc,
           interval_start_local,
           demand_mw - wind_mw - solar_mw AS net_load_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY demand_mw - wind_mw - solar_mw DESC, interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM netload
), target AS (
    SELECT interval_start_utc
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
), hourly_rt AS (

      AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
    GROUP BY r.iso_id, r.location_id, DATE_TRUNC('hour', r.interval_start_utc)
)
SELECT hourly_rt.avg_rt_lmp - da.lmp AS answer_usd_per_mwh

WITH peak AS (
  SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  WHERE b.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND b.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
),
peak_hours AS (
  SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc
  FROM peak WHERE rn = 1
),
shares AS (
  SELECT p.iso_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind','solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(SUM(g.generation_mw), 0) AS renewable_share
  FROM peak_hours p
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  GROUP BY p.iso_id
)
SELECT 100 * (MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN renewable_share END)
            - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN renewable_share END)) AS percentage_points
FROM shares s
JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = s.iso_id

WITH peak AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code IN ('CAISO', 'ERCOT')
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
), selected AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc
    FROM peak WHERE rn = 1
), fuel_totals AS (
    SELECT g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_5min g
    JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
), shares AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id,
           SUM(ft.wind_solar_mw) / NULLIF(b.net_generation_mw, 0) AS share
    FROM selected p
    JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly b ON b.iso_id = p.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    JOIN fuel_totals ft ON ft.iso_id = p.iso_id AND ft.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
    GROUP BY p.iso_id, b.net_generation_mw
)
